Priya: <3 team effort. Also grabbed a box of bagels on the way to the office this morning — left them in kitchen, help yourselves. :bagel:
Sam: Bagels + saved demo = best morning. Ops-team MVPs :tada:

Jordan: Can we add the rollback command to the runbook? small PR incoming.
Ava: yes please, Jordan. Also reminder for managers — nominate for quarterly kudos deck!
Ops-Bot: Incident 2026-17686 resolved by luis, priya. Auto-note: uptime restored at 08:12UTC.

Priya: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/wow-team-highfive-3o7btPCcdNniyf0ArS :raised_hands:

Jordan: 1
